description: Figure 8 is a line plot that illustrates the relative change in performance of the Mistral-7B-v0.2 model as a result of layer-wise quantized pruning, with SnapKV as the pruning method. The x-axis represents different layers of the model, labeled as Layer-4, Layer-5-12, Layer-13-20, Layer-21-28, and Layer-29-32. The y-axis measures the relative change in performance, ranging from -15% to 3%. There are four lines in the plot, each representing a different configuration of the model: LB-Avg of 2 tokens, 8-bit; LB-Avg of 1 token, 16-bit; RULER4k of 2 tokens, 8-bit; and RULER4k of 1 token, 16-bit. The lines are color-coded and have different markers and line styles, but the specific details of these attributes are not provided in the description. The plot shows that the performance change varies across different layers and configurations, with some layers experiencing a significant drop in performance, particularly in the RULER4k configurations.
